purpose.summary: Batch program that creates/updates monthly statistical data files for the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt (claims) software system. It reads patient insurance, diagnosis, treatment-act, and other master records and writes three indexed statistical data files (TOUKEI01/02/03) plus an error file. It is part of the monthly statistics subsystem of a Japanese medical billing application.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims)

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY … REPLACING with // delimiter syntax for copybook inclusion
Multiple indexed files opened in both DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes simultaneously via separate FD entries sharing the same ASSIGN target
Japanese comments encoded in Latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS bytes mis-decoded), indicating a Japanese-language source base
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for job parameter passing
Large working-storage with OCCURS tables for insurance combination and statistical data
No COMP-3 packed-decimal usage despite numeric fields — all PIC 9 display
60 CALL statements indicating heavy use of external subprograms (date conversion, DB search, job control, etc.)
Open-source JMA ORCA project copyright header
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), appearing as mojibake. Source is truncated to 16000 chars out of ~141 KB; the PROCEDURE DIVISION body is largely unseen but structural indicators (100 PERFORMs, 60 CALLs, 11 GOTOs, 3053 lines) confirm a substantial production batch program. The // REPLACING delimiter style is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/Micro Focus rather than IBM Enterprise COBOL.
